question: After both routes certify the identical exact finite prefix, do recurrent service profiles admit complete physical policies that a tight completion-only recurrence cannot admit?
design: Deterministic exhaustive reanalysis of an existing finite mathematical parameter family. Not independent workloads, statistical sampling, native execution, elapsed-time measurement, or a new hardware experiment.
input_family: Unmodified R30_PRODUCER_FAMILY_RESULTS.json: all p1..12,q1..3p,s0=0..p-1, 1950 entries. Retain 328 timing-tie rejections and all 1622 timing-admitted sources. Preserve all finite prefixes and recurrent cycles, including all 764 nonempty transients.
primary_grid: P1..2p, phi0..P-1, K1/2, identical to R30/R35.
expanded_grid: P1..4p, phi0..P-1, K1..5, identical to R35 and disclosed as posthoc in that earlier analysis. No new grid chosen from prefix outcomes.
source_entry: First read at s0 assumes a fresh valid tag and disabled timer. The finite prefix followed by translated cycle supplies all predecessor/next-read edges conditional on successful service. First-failure induction lifts positive complete slack to all optional zero-byte WU words in the specified receiver. Other invalidation, revocation, overflow and binding violations are excluded/rejected.
exact_service: Epre=min over original finite prefix of F_P(s+1)-h, +infinity for empty prefix. Erec uses m=gcd(P,d) only in the remainder, B=(K-1)P remains physical. Efull=min(Epre,Erec). Positive Efull, fresh entry, physical-policy binding, verified source/control assumptions and prefix/receiver digests define full policy admission; timing-source admission is separate.
main_fair_baseline: Both routes share identical Epre. Use actual cycle completions C0 and tight cycle Jr=max(c-s), Ar=max(h-c) to compute Drec, then Dshared=min(Epre,Drec). Compare Efull>0 to Dshared>0. Thus no rescue can arise from degrading the finite-prefix analysis.
diagnostic_baselines: Also report Dsegment=min(Dpre(Jp,Ap,Cpre),Drec(Jr,Ar,C0)), with +infinity for absent prefix, and Dglobal=min(Dpre(Jall,Aall,Cpre),Drec(Jall,Aall,C0)), with extrema over prefix+cycle. Neither diagnostic replaces the stronger common-exact-prefix main baseline. Verify Dglobal<=Dsegment<=Dshared<=Efull for all physical queries.
storage_support: Keep R35 fixed g=d/gcd(d,3), unsupported when m does not divide g. Report disjoint supported full-positive, supported unknown, unsupported; report full producer/master totals separately. Never relabel unsupported as a compact answer. Record full positive service-only/shared-completion baseline counts with both all-source and nonempty-transient strata.
independent_checks: Reconstruct all source phase paths without invoking old launcher. Recompute gcd recurrence by explicit P/m translated copies and physical expiry map for every P/phi, independent of profile projection. Prefix uses original absolute times and physical P. Independently simulate one-WU-at-s+1 countdown at each minimizing witness for every K, including nonpositive first-failure witnesses. Check positive-safety refinement by latest-arm monotonicity and first-failure proof, not finite sampled WU words. Reproduce prior recurrent query totals as consistency controls. Every negative/zero slack and timing-tie rejection is retained.
outputs: Hashed protocol/script/input manifests, per-entry aggregates and all rejected records, primary/expanded full outcome counts, transient strata, all loss/rescue counters, fair-baseline definitions, a local proof/within-tick table and source-key invariant, and concise paper-ready conclusions. No cost memoization, performance or native conformance claims.
skill_guidance: experimental-design: fix domain, responses and controls before computation; distinguish deterministic parameter entries from independent replicates. User instruction excludes unrelated skill-promotional manuscript references. No randomization or power analysis applies to exhaustive finite identities.
